stats.notes: rel placement is computed DIRECTLY as (grasp EEF world xy - frame0 base xy), matching the eval convention obj_rel = obj_abs - init_robot_base_pos (world axes, jittered base); the originally planned per-layout affine abs->rel fit is impossible to make near-exact because rel depends on the per-episode base jitter (all single-affine R2 in 0.21-0.99, residual = jitter). Layout = anchor whose rotated jitter box (+-0.05 toward-counter, +-0.15 along-counter, yaw-matched) contains the demo base; ambig=1 when >1 anchor box fits (same-wall layouts overlap within jitter, e.g. 20/36 at 0.015 m) or none strictly fits; layout label for ambig rows is the best-fitting candidate and its confusions are near-identical-geometry same-wall layouts, so r/x/y/side/h/w are unaffected. side = sign of the rel axis whose sign splits the two counter placement regions for the assigned layout (yaw-rule fallback). h/w = per-category eval means; cat indexes the shared cats array from fx_episodes.json (kettle -> kettle_non_electric alias). Placement nulled when |x| or |y| > 1.1.
